decision: Required to start the race from the pit lane.
event_name: Date 29 August 2021 Time 13:54 2021 BELGIAN GRAND PRIX 26 - 29 August 2021 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Technical Delegate (document 31), have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: The rear wing assembly has been changed and is of a different specification.
offence: Breach of Article 34.8 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Required to start the race from the pit lane.
reason: The changed rear wing assembly is of a different specification from the one used during qualifying. The part was replaced with the approval of the FIA Technical Delegate as per Article 34.2. As the rear wing assembly is a different specification and was changed whilst the car was in parc ferme, the competitor is required to start the race from the pit lane per Article 34.8 b) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
rules_referenced: Article 34.8 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 7 Rear Wing Assembly
